overview_description.description:
Hakim AI — Arabic-First AI infrastructure for Developers & Creators

The speech intelligence layer the Arabic internet has been waiting for.
Hakim gives developers and creators state-of-the-art TTS, STT, and voice cloning — built natively for Arabic, not retrofitted from English. Most voice APIs treat Arabic as an afterthought. Hakim was designed around it from day one: 15 Arabic dialects (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Moroccan, Iraqi, and more), native diacritics handling, right-to-left text, and Arabic-English code-switching in the same sentence.
